scoring_justification: The checker recomputes step positions and plateau binding energies from the raw CSV artifacts and compares them to hidden paper‐derived gold values; no trust in agent‐reported metrics.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold step positions and plateau binding energies for Cu/Au and Ag/Au isotherms.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from explicit numbers and snapshot µ values in the paper: bulk Cu cohesive -3.61 eV, cavity-filled binding -3.57 eV; first-layer above ~-3.58 eV; Ag monolayer binding -2.9211 eV, cavity-bottom layer -3.058 eV; snapshot µ values for Ag from Fig.8 caption (-3.155, -3.12, -3.03, -3.00, -2.87).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Collected directly from text and figure descriptions; tolerances chosen to accommodate implementation differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every value is explicitly stated in the paper or directly derivable from its figures and text.

outputs.description: Cu/Au adsorption isotherm: number of deposited Cu atoms and average binding energy per atom as functions of chemical potential.
Ag/Au adsorption isotherm: number of deposited Ag atoms and average binding energy per atom as functions of chemical potential.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the step positions (chemical potentials where num_atoms increases abruptly) and the plateau values of avg_binding_energy against hidden gold values extracted from the paper's figures. Only the CSV files are required; energy histograms and excess energy analysis are not scored outputs.
